newsitem.title: USA: NY extends Rochester Gas filing deadline.
newsitem.headline: NY extends Rochester Gas filing deadline.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission said the filing date for a settlement date in Rochester Gas & Electric Corp's restructuring filing has been extended to April 8 from March 25 to all further negotiations.
In a notice issued March 20, the commission also established a hearing schedule in its Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc case based on a settlement agreement being filed Tuesday, March 25.
As of Monday afternoon, there had been no change in that schedule, commission spokesman David Flanagan told Reuters.
The schedule calls for commission hearings May 19 through 22 and filing of supplemental post-hearing briefs on May 30.
Flanagan said no change had been made yet in New York State Electric & Gas Corp's March 25 filing deadline.
